title: Runtime timing samples
responsibility: Times complete runtime invocations and summarizes warmed samples or repeated rounds into latency and throughput measurements.

inputs.name: median.values
inputs.description: Numeric samples to sort on a copy; meaningful medians require a nonempty array.

inputs.name: timeCall.runtime
inputs.description: Initialized runtime whose invoke method performs the whole operation being timed.

inputs.name: timeCall.request
inputs.description: Operation and optional input to pass unchanged to the runtime.

inputs.name: benchSamples.runtime
inputs.description: Initialized runtime used for three warm-up calls and then every measured call.

inputs.name: benchSamples.request
inputs.description: Operation and optional input repeated for warm-up and measurement.

inputs.name: benchSamples.iterations
inputs.description: Number of timed calls after warm-up; callers should supply a positive integer.

inputs.name: benchRounds.runtime
inputs.description: Initialized runtime used for warm-up and all measured rounds.

inputs.name: benchRounds.request
inputs.description: Operation and optional input repeated in every call.

inputs.name: benchRounds.shape
inputs.description: Positive integer round and per-round call counts. This helper does not validate them.

inputs.name: roundMeasurements.result
inputs.description: Round summary containing the fastest call, median of round medians, throughput and total sample count.

inputs.name: roundMeasurements.where
inputs.description: Human-readable description of where calls were timed, included in each measurement method.

outputs.name: median
outputs.description: Middle sorted value, or the average of the two middle values. An empty input yields NaN.

outputs.name: timeCall
outputs.description: Elapsed milliseconds for one successful whole invocation, including the runtime transport work.

outputs.name: benchSamples
outputs.description: Median call latency, calls per second based on total measured duration, and the requested iteration count after three warm-up calls.

outputs.name: benchRounds
outputs.description: Fastest single call, median of round medians, calls per second derived from that median, and rounds times iterations samples.

outputs.name: roundMeasurements
outputs.description: Three entries for latency-floor-ms, latency-warm-ms and throughput-ops, each with its value, unit and boundary description.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when an invocation returns ok: false, naming the runtime kind and failure message. Invocation promise rejections also propagate.
